channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Japan: BoJ inflation focus and rate risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley examines Japanese inflation dynamics and Bank of Japan policy. The report notes elevated Oil prices and supply risks, but stresses BoJ’s focus on core inflation and wage-driven pressures after decades of deflation.

item.title: Singapore: Strong growth momentum defies risks – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Chua Han Teng highlights that Singapore’s economy is set to deliver above-trend growth for a third straight year in 2026, supported by manufacturing, wholesale trade and financial services.

item.title: Gold pauses near two-month high as Oil swings shape Fed outlook
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) pauses its rally on Tuesday after hitting a two-month high of $4,435 earlier in Asian trading hours. Price action remains driven by movements in Oil prices and their impact on the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) interest-rate outlook.

item.title: Euro: Rangebound against US Dollar as volatility sinks – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING observes that EUR/USD realised volatility continues to decline, with one-year volatility matching lows from November 2024.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Heading back toward 160 against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank notes that the Japanese Yen has weakened again above 159 per Dollar despite recent intervention and Bank of Japan signals.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles as impact of joint intervention fades
item.description: USD/JPY treads water on Tuesday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) struggles to find its footing, facing headwinds from a firmer US Dollar (USD) and elevated Oil prices. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 159.24 after hitting an intraday low of 158.92.

item.title: US ADP Employment Change 4-week average drops to 8.25K
item.description: Private-sector hiring in the US has further cooled in late July. According to the NER Pulse, the weekly companion to the ADP National Employment Report, companies added an average of 8.25K jobs per week in the four weeks ending July 25.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA softens hawkish stance – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) delivered a less hawkish hold, keeping rates at 4.35% and judging policy “somewhat restrictive” as the labor market has eased more than expected.

item.title: Silver retreats toward $65.00 as Oil rebound revives inflation concerns
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its correction on Tuesday and trades around $65.05 at the time of writing, down 2.31% on the day.

item.title: US Dollar: CPI keeps USD in tight ranges – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note the US Dollar (USD) softened as Fed hike expectations moderated and the US yield curve steepened.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds below 0.8100 US Dollar with US-Iran negotiations deadlocked
item.description: The Swiss Franc trades practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, consolidating halfway through last week’s trading range.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds Descending Triangle breakout
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades marginally lower at around 1.3500 during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Qatar says Oman-Iran talks reach advanced stage
item.description: Talks between Oman and Iran have reached an advanced stage, Qatar’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson said on Tuesday.

item.title: Natural gas: European prices surge as LNG flows stall – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report that European Natural gas benchmark TTF jumped over 9%, moving back above EUR60/MWh as hopes for a US–Iran deal fade.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Wider range with intervention support against US Dollar – HSBC
item.description: HSBC strategists discuss the sharp post-intervention drop following coordinated action by Japan’s Ministry of Finance and the US Treasury. They argue that joint intervention is more effective than unilateral moves but unlikely to change the broader trend without improved Japanese fundamentals.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: A break above 100.00 would confirm a double bottom
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) appreciates for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, favoured by a mix of concerns about the stalled US-Iran negotiations and hawkish Fed speak, which keeps hopes of a September rate hike alive.

item.title: Euro treads water against US Dollar as traders await US CPI
item.description: EUR/USD trades around 1.1535 on Tuesday at the time of writing, posting a modest 0.06% decline on the day.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: Rally hits pause near $4,440 with US CPI in focus
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades 0.26% lower at around $4,380 during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Focus shifts to 0.5850 support area as risk appetite fades
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) nudges lower against a firmer US Dollar (USD) for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, as doubts about the fate of the US-Iran peace negotiations hurt market confidence and boost Oil prices higher.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA keeps door open – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen reports that the Australian Dollar (AUD) slipped briefly after the RBA left its policy rate unchanged, as markets interpreted the statement and downgraded growth and inflation forecasts as dovish.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges up, RBA hawkish hold does little to revive rate hike expectations
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) attracts bids against its major currency peers after the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) monetary policy decision, but is still trading marginally lower at around 0.7050 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains near two-month highs against US Dollar as Oil prices rise
item.description: USD/CAD trades around 1.3935 on Tuesday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day with a modest 0.03% decline.

item.title: WTI Oil hits fresh highs at $83.50 as Hormuz reopening hopes vanish
item.description: Oil prices rally for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, with the barrel of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trading at $83.50 during the European trading session.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Dovish repricing on data and inflation focus – BNY
item.description: John Velis at BNY Markets reiterates that he expects no Federal Reserve rate hikes this year, even as risks remain skewed to the upside.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.78 per troy ounce, down 2.72% from the $66.59 it cost on Monday.

item.title: Brent: Inflation risks rise with Hormuz standoff – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that Brent Oil has broken above $85, closing near $88 as the Strait of Hormuz remains shut and rhetoric between the US and Iran escalates.

item.title: Indian Rupee falls as oil prices extend rally, India-US CPI data awaited
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a cautious note against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair rises further to near 95.40 as surging oil prices due to escalating fears of a prolonged global supply disruption have weakened the Indian currency.

item.title: US Dollar: Volatility sinks as carry trades hold – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that FX volatility is falling as investors appear comfortable with the Federal Reserve holding or potentially tightening rates in September.

item.title: British Pound sits near one-week top, above 215.00 vs weak Yen ahead of UK GDP
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross recovers a modest intraday dip and climbs above the 215.00 psychological mark during the first half of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro falls against Canadian Dollar as US-Iran tensions heighten oil supply concerns
item.description: EUR/CAD continues its losing streak for the fifth consecutive day, trading around 1.6080 during the European hours on Tuesday. The Euro (EUR) is under pressure as rising risk aversion, driven by escalating US-Iran tensions, weighs on the cross.
